rounds.hint: Opposites are as different as can be, like up and down.

games.name: Wonder Lab
games.story: Fill {buddy}'s discovery notebook with new wonders.
games.say_intro: Welcome to my Wonder Lab! Let's guess what happens, and find out why.
cheers: A new page for my notebook!
end_lines: My notebook is full of wonders now!
Five discoveries today. You're a real scientist!
So many new things! Let's tell Amma.
The Wonder Lab is closing. See you soon!

rounds.say: Ice cream sits in the hot sun. What happens to it?
rounds.hint: Think: what does the hot sun do to cold things?
rounds.why: The sun is hot, so the ice cream melts into a puddle.

rounds.say: We plant a seed. We give it water and sunshine. What will it become?
rounds.hint: Seeds need water and sun to grow.
rounds.why: With water and sunshine, a seed grows into a plant with flowers.

rounds.prompt: What comes out of the egg?
rounds.say: A mother hen sits on her egg. What comes out of the egg?
rounds.hint: Who laid the egg? A hen!
rounds.why: A baby chick hatches from a hen's egg.

rounds.say: A little caterpillar eats and eats, then sleeps. What does it become?
rounds.hint: It grows beautiful wings.
rounds.why: A caterpillar turns into a butterfly!

rounds.say: Big dark clouds fill the Bangalore sky. What comes next?
rounds.hint: What falls from the sky on a cloudy day?
rounds.why: Dark clouds are full of water, so rain falls.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: A pin pokes a balloon. I think the balloon grows bigger! Oops, is that right? What really happens?
rounds.hint: A pin is sharp. Balloons are thin.
rounds.why: Pop! The sharp pin makes a hole, and the air rushes out.

rounds.prompt: What comes after rain and sun?
rounds.say: It is raining, and the sun comes out too. What do we see in the sky?
rounds.hint: It has many colours and makes an arch.
rounds.why: Sunlight shines through raindrops and makes a rainbow.

rounds.say: Thatha throws a ball up high. What happens next?
rounds.hint: Do things stay up in the air?
rounds.why: The ball falls back down. The Earth pulls everything down.

rounds.say: We heat dry popcorn seeds in a hot pan. Pop, pop, pop! What do they become?
rounds.hint: Listen: pop, pop, pop!
rounds.why: Hot, dry popcorn seeds pop into popcorn!

rounds.say: Who gives us milk for Amma's coffee?
rounds.hint: This animal says moo.
rounds.why: A cow gives us milk.

rounds.say: Bees visit flowers all day. What do bees make?
rounds.hint: It is sweet and sticky.
rounds.why: Bees make honey from flowers.

rounds.say: Your hands are dirty after playing in the park with Appa. What makes them clean?
rounds.hint: We use it with water at the sink.
rounds.why: Soap and water wash away dirt and germs.

rounds.say: Thatha's tall tree has big leaves on top. What grows on it?
rounds.hint: It is hard and brown, with sweet water inside.
rounds.why: Coconuts grow on coconut trees. Ajji uses them in chutney!

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: Lots of water. I think a camel lives here! Oops, is that right? Who really lives here?
rounds.hint: This animal swims with fins.
rounds.why: Fish live in water. They breathe with gills.

rounds.say: Hot sand everywhere, a desert. Who lives here?
rounds.hint: This animal can walk a long way without water.
rounds.why: Camels live in the desert. They can go a long time without water.

rounds.say: Ice and snow, very cold. Who lives here?
rounds.hint: This bird cannot fly, but it swims and slides on ice.
rounds.why: Penguins live where it is icy and cold.

rounds.say: Tall trees with lots of branches. Who lives here?
rounds.hint: This animal swings from branch to branch.
rounds.why: Monkeys live in trees. Lots of them live in Bangalore!

rounds.say: Look at this web. Who made it?
rounds.hint: This small animal has eight legs.
rounds.why: A spider spins a web to catch food.

rounds.say: A cosy hole in the ground. Who lives here?
rounds.hint: This animal has long ears and digs.
rounds.why: Rabbits dig holes called burrows to live in.

rounds.prompt: What does a chick grow into?
rounds.say: A little chick grows bigger and bigger. What does it become?
rounds.hint: Who laid the egg it came from?
rounds.why: A chick grows up into a hen or a rooster.

rounds.say: We put snow next to a fire. What happens?
rounds.hint: Fire is hot. Snow is cold.
rounds.why: The heat melts the snow into water.

rounds.say: Nobody waters Ajji's flower pot for many days. What happens?
rounds.hint: Plants get thirsty, just like us.
rounds.why: Without water, the flower droops. Plants need water to live.

rounds.say: A magnet pulls some things close. Which one will it pull?
rounds.hint: Magnets like some metal things.
rounds.why: Magnets pull some metals, like an iron paper clip.

rounds.say: A car needs something to go. What does it need?
rounds.hint: We fill it at the petrol pump.
rounds.why: Cars need petrol, or a battery charge, to go.

rounds.say: Mmm, Ajji's jasmine flowers! Which part of you smells them?
rounds.hint: It is in the middle of your face.
rounds.why: We smell with our nose.

rounds.say: Boom, boom! A drum! Which part of you hears it?
rounds.hint: You have two of them, on the sides of your head.
rounds.why: We hear with our ears.

rounds.prompt: What grows on it one day?
rounds.say: Thatha plants a mango seed. Years go by, and it grows into a big tree. What grows on the tree?
rounds.hint: A mango seed grows into a mango tree.
rounds.why: A mango seed becomes a mango tree, and the tree gives us mangoes!

rounds.prompt: What will it lay one day?
rounds.say: A hen lays an egg. A chick hatches, and grows into a hen. What will she lay one day?
rounds.hint: It goes round and round, like a circle.
rounds.why: Egg, chick, hen, and then a new egg. It goes round and round!

rounds.say: Dark clouds come over Bangalore. Rain falls for a long time. What do we see on the road?
rounds.hint: Where does all the rain water go?
rounds.why: The rain water collects into puddles. Splash!

rounds.say: We leave a bowl of water in the hot sun all day. In the evening, it is empty! Where did the water go?
rounds.hint: Wet clothes dry in the sun. Where does their water go?
rounds.why: The sun warms the water, and it goes up into the air. Later it makes clouds.

rounds.say: Two plants sit in the sun. Only one plant got water. It grew big. What was different?
rounds.hint: Look: what does the first plant have that the second does not?
rounds.why: Only the water was different. So water helps plants grow!

rounds.say: Appa has two chocolates. One is in the hot sun. One is in the cold fridge. Which one melts first?
rounds.hint: Which place is warmer?
rounds.why: The one in the sun melts first. Heat melts chocolate.

rounds.say: Two pots with the same seeds. One is by the sunny window. One is in a dark cupboard. Which grows best?
rounds.hint: Plants need something from the sky to grow.
rounds.why: The pot by the window grows best. Plants need sunlight.

rounds.prompt: What did the fresh flower get?
rounds.say: Both flowers had sunshine. One stayed fresh, one drooped. What did the fresh one get?
rounds.hint: Plants get thirsty, just like us.
rounds.why: The fresh flower got water. Water keeps plants fresh.

rounds.say: We drop these in a bucket of water. Which one sinks to the bottom?
rounds.hint: Light things float. Heavy metal things sink.
rounds.why: A key is heavy metal, so it sinks. A leaf and a balloon float.

rounds.prompt: What comes out of the pot?
rounds.say: Amma heats water for filter coffee. It gets very hot. What comes out of the pot?
rounds.hint: Look above a hot cup of coffee.
rounds.why: Very hot water turns into steam, and it rises up.

rounds.say: Amma adds a spoon of curd to warm milk, and waits all night. What is in the bowl in the morning?
rounds.hint: The little bit of curd changes all the milk.
rounds.why: The milk becomes a bowl of curd, mosaru! Tiny helpers in the curd change the milk.

rounds.say: Amma hangs two wet shirts. One is in the hot sun. One is in the shade. Which dries first?
rounds.hint: Which place is warmer?
rounds.why: The shirt in the sun dries first. The heat takes the water away.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: We drop a key in water. I think the heavy key floats! Oops, is that right? What really happens?
rounds.hint: Is a key heavy or light?
rounds.why: A heavy key sinks to the bottom.

rounds.say: Put your hand on your chest. Thump, thump! Which part pumps blood around your body?
rounds.hint: It beats faster when you run.
rounds.why: Your heart pumps blood all around your body.

rounds.say: Crunch, crunch, a carrot! What helps you chew?
rounds.hint: They are white, inside your mouth.
rounds.why: Your teeth bite and chew your food.

rounds.say: Mmm, sweet mango! What helps you taste it?
rounds.hint: It is pink, and it is inside your mouth.
rounds.why: Your tongue tastes sweet, salty and sour.

rounds.prompt: Which one comes from an egg?
rounds.say: Which baby animal comes out of an egg?
rounds.hint: This one has a shell and lays eggs in the sand.
rounds.why: Baby turtles hatch from eggs. Puppies and calves do not.

rounds.say: Which baby rides on its mother's back?
rounds.hint: Look at the monkeys on Bangalore trees!
rounds.why: Baby monkeys hold on to their mothers and ride on them.

rounds.say: It is a very hot summer day in Bangalore. What helps you cool down?
rounds.hint: Something juicy and cold.
rounds.why: Cool, juicy watermelon helps on a hot day.

rounds.say: The rainy season comes. At night, who sings croak, croak?
rounds.hint: It hops and says croak.
rounds.why: Frogs sing in the rainy season. They love the puddles!

rounds.prompt: What do we wear on cold mornings?
rounds.say: It is a cold December morning. What do we wear?
rounds.hint: Something warm for your body.
rounds.why: A warm jacket or sweater keeps us cosy.

rounds.say: What gives us light in the day?
rounds.hint: It is big, bright and hot.
rounds.why: The sun gives us daylight.

rounds.prompt: Which planet do we live on?
rounds.say: Which one is our home planet?
rounds.hint: It has blue seas and green land.
rounds.why: We live on planet Earth!

rounds.prompt: Which star is closest to us?
rounds.say: Here is a surprise! Which one is the star closest to us?
rounds.hint: It is a star you see in the day!
rounds.why: The sun is a star! It is the closest star to Earth.

rounds.prompt: Where does a plant make food?
rounds.say: Plants make their own food from sunlight. Which part makes the food?
rounds.hint: This part is green and flat.
rounds.why: Green leaves make food from sunlight.

rounds.say: What does a plant need to grow?
rounds.hint: Plants drink it, just like us.
rounds.why: Plants need water, and sunlight too.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: I think the moon gives us daylight! Oops, is that right? What really gives us light in the day?
rounds.hint: It is big, bright and hot.
rounds.why: The sun gives us daylight. The moon shines at night.

rounds.prompt: What does a seed need first?
rounds.say: A dry seed is sleeping. What does it need first to wake up and sprout?
rounds.hint: Ajji soaks moong in water to make sprouts!
rounds.why: Water wakes a seed up. That's how moong sprouts!

rounds.say: Which animal eats only plants?
rounds.hint: It eats grass all day.
rounds.why: A cow eats only plants, like grass.

rounds.say: What can take people to the moon?
rounds.hint: It goes up, up, up, very fast.
rounds.why: A rocket can fly all the way to the moon.

rounds.say: The moon has no light of its own. What makes it shine?
rounds.hint: The biggest light in the sky shines on it.
rounds.why: Sunlight bounces off the moon. That's why it shines!

rounds.say: The sun, or the Earth. Which one is bigger?
rounds.hint: The sun looks small because it is very far away.
rounds.why: The sun is much, much bigger than the Earth!

rounds.say: Take a big breath in. What do we breathe in?
rounds.hint: You can't see it, but you can feel it.
rounds.why: We breathe in air. Our body needs it all the time.

rounds.say: We put water in the freezer all night. What does it become?
rounds.hint: The freezer is very cold.
rounds.why: Very cold water turns into ice!

rounds.prompt: What happens to melted ice cream?
rounds.say: Your ice cream melted into a puddle. Amma puts it back in the freezer. What happens?
rounds.hint: Cold makes melted things hard again.
rounds.why: It freezes into ice cream again! Some changes can go back.

rounds.say: Will a magnet pull a wooden spoon?
rounds.hint: Magnets pull some metals, not wood.
rounds.why: No! Magnets do not pull wood.

rounds.say: A small bell, or a big drum. Which makes a higher sound?
rounds.hint: Small things often make higher sounds.
rounds.why: A small bell goes ting! A big drum goes boom.

rounds.say: Which animal wakes up at night to hunt?
rounds.hint: It has big round eyes and says hoot.
rounds.why: Owls hunt at night. Their big eyes see in the dark.

rounds.say: Roots are under the ground. What do they drink?
rounds.hint: Plants drink it when it rains.
rounds.why: Roots drink water from the soil.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: We drop a coconut in water. I think it sinks! Oops, is that right? Will a coconut float?
rounds.hint: Coconuts travel across the sea!
rounds.why: Yes! A coconut floats. It has air inside.

games.name: All About Me
games.story: Make {buddy}'s Explorer card all about YOU.
games.say_intro: Let's make your Explorer card! I want to know all about you.
games.privacy: No personal value is shown, spoken or stored. The public build has no address, phone or recite rounds; the only keypad round is the public 112 help number (check: literal).
cheers: Now I know more about you!
A new line on your card!
You know so much about you!
end_lines: Your Explorer card is looking great!
Now I know you even better. Thank you!
Safe and smart! See you soon.
Let's show your card to Amma!

rounds.say: Your name! Which letter does your name start with?
rounds.hint: Look at the first letter of your name on the screen.
rounds.why: Yes! That is the first letter of your name.

rounds.say: Look at your birthday cake. How many candles? How old are you?
rounds.hint: Count the candles, one by one.
rounds.why: Yes! That is how old you are. What a big explorer!

rounds.say: Five, and then what comes next?
rounds.hint: Count: four, five, then?
rounds.why: Five, six! After five comes six.

rounds.say: You get a new toy. How do you feel?
rounds.hint: Think: is a new toy a nice thing?
rounds.why: A new toy makes us happy!

rounds.say: Your ice cream falls on the ground. How might you feel?
rounds.hint: Is it nice when your ice cream falls?
rounds.why: It's OK to feel sad. A hug can help.

rounds.say: Which fruit do you like best?
rounds.hint: There is no wrong answer. Pick the one you like!
rounds.why: Yum! I'll put it on your Explorer card.

rounds.say: Which colour do you like best?
rounds.hint: There is no wrong answer. Pick the one you like!
rounds.why: Lovely colour! I'll put it on your Explorer card.

rounds.prompt: Which city do we live in?
rounds.say: Which city do we live in? Bengaluru, Delhi, or Mumbai?
rounds.hint: Our city is also called Bangalore.
rounds.why: We live in Bengaluru, also called Bangalore!

rounds.say: This is the help number, one, one, two. Press one, one, two on the buttons!
rounds.hint: Find one, then one again, then two.
rounds.why: Well done! One, one, two is the number for help in an emergency.
rounds.parent_help: Grown-up: sit with your child and practise the number together. It is never shown on screen.

rounds.prompt: Who can you ask for help?
rounds.say: You can't find Amma in a shop. Who can you ask for help?
rounds.hint: Look for someone in a uniform.
rounds.why: A police officer can help you find Amma.

rounds.say: Point to your eyes! Which picture shows eyes?
rounds.hint: Eyes help you see.
rounds.why: Eyes! You see with your eyes.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: I think we live on the moon! Oops, is that right? Which one is our home?
rounds.hint: We live here, with land and sea.
rounds.why: We live on planet Earth!

rounds.say: Look at your name. How many letters does it have?
rounds.hint: Point to each letter and count.
rounds.why: Yes! That's how many letters are in your name.

rounds.say: On your next birthday, you will be one year older. How old will you be?
rounds.hint: Count your candles, then one more.
rounds.why: Yes! One more candle next birthday!

rounds.prompt: Which state do we live in?
rounds.say: Bengaluru is in our state. Which one is it? Goa, Karnataka, or Kerala?
rounds.hint: We speak Kannada in our state.
rounds.why: Bengaluru is in Karnataka!

rounds.say: You are lost in a big shop. What should you do first?
rounds.hint: Running away makes it harder for Amma to find you.
rounds.why: Stop and stay where you are. Then ask a safe helper.

rounds.say: Someone you don't know says, come with me, I have sweets. What do you say?
rounds.hint: We never go anywhere with someone we don't know.
rounds.why: Say no, and go to Amma or Appa right away.

rounds.say: You are lost in a shop. Which one is a safe helper to ask?
rounds.hint: Look for a family, or someone working in the shop.
rounds.why: A mother with children, or a shopkeeper, can help you.

rounds.prompt: Where do we go when sick?
rounds.say: When we are very sick, where do we go?
rounds.hint: Doctors and nurses work there.
rounds.why: The hospital helps us get well.

rounds.say: Where can we buy milk and bread?
rounds.hint: It is a shop near home.
rounds.why: The shop sells milk and bread.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: I think one hand has six fingers! Oops, is that right? How many fingers are there really?
rounds.hint: Count each finger.
rounds.why: One hand has five fingers!

rounds.say: Your friend fell down and is crying. What can you do?
rounds.hint: What would make your friend feel better?
rounds.why: A kind hug, or getting a grown-up, helps your friend.

rounds.prompt: {buddy} got it wrong! Can you fix it?
rounds.say: I think Bengaluru is in Japan! Oops, is that right? Which country do we really live in?
rounds.hint: Our flag is orange, white and green.
rounds.why: We live in India!

rounds.say: Bengaluru has another name too. What is it? Chennai, Mysuru, or Bangalore?
rounds.hint: It sounds a lot like Bengaluru!
rounds.why: Bengaluru is also called Bangalore!

rounds.say: Which number do we call in an emergency? Nine nine nine, three four five, or one one two?
rounds.hint: One, one, two!
rounds.why: One, one, two is the help number in India.

rounds.prompt: When do we call for help?
rounds.say: When should a grown-up call the help number?
rounds.hint: Is it a big danger, or a small wish?
rounds.why: We call for help when there is real danger, like a fire.

rounds.prompt: What helps the police find Amma?
rounds.say: You are lost. What can you tell a police officer to help find Amma?
rounds.hint: It's the number we practised!
rounds.why: Amma's phone number helps the police call her.

rounds.prompt: How old were you last year?
rounds.say: Last year you were one year younger. How old were you?
rounds.hint: Count your candles, then take one away.
rounds.why: Yes! Last year you had one candle less.

rounds.say: How many fingers on both hands?
rounds.hint: Count all your fingers, one by one.
rounds.why: Five and five make ten fingers!

rounds.say: You feel very angry. What can help you feel calm?
rounds.hint: Sit down and breathe slowly.
rounds.why: Sitting quietly and taking slow breaths helps us feel calm.

rounds.prompt: What do you like to do?
rounds.say: What do you like to do best?
rounds.hint: There is no wrong answer. Pick the one you like!
rounds.why: That sounds fun! I'll put it on your Explorer card.

rounds.say: Look at your name. Which letter is in your name?
rounds.hint: Look at each letter of your name.
rounds.why: Yes! That letter is in your name.
